HOW WE COORDINATE

One clear brief, with each decision made visible.

Define the market and customer

Set the destination country, sales channel, customer need, target positioning and first-order scale before selecting a formula direction.

Build a useful product shortlist

Use the 75 product types as a range-planning catalogue. Skincare, haircare and styling are core strengths; additional categories are assessed against the brief and confirmed supplier scope.

Confirm the product-specific route

Coordinate samples, packaging, specifications and current documents with the manufacturing partner. Final feasibility, formula and timing are confirmed for the selected project.

CLEAR RESPONSIBILITIES

Project coordination and manufacturing are described separately.

Guangzhou Huanyue manages customer communication and project coordination. Guangdong Zhengutang Biotechnology Co., Ltd. is the named manufacturing partner for projects that fit its confirmed scope. Partner certificates and manufacturing records belong to that partner; request current copies and confirm their scope and validity before relying on them.
